h2.text: Please don't scroll yet. Give me two minutes, and I will show you what I have done.

d1.text: I started my career in 2023 as a Guest Relations Officer at Daniels Holiday Homes.

d2.text: I was responsible for welcoming guests, checking them in, and supporting them throughout their stay.

d3.text: During my time there, guest review scores increased by 25%, and guest satisfaction increased by 20%.

d4.text: I also helped reduce the front desk workload by 40% with digital concierge tools, and I reduced onboarding time by 20%.

d5.text: This role taught me how to understand what a guest needs, and how to solve problems quickly.

s1.text: I then joined Stonetree as a Customer Care Agent, and I was promoted to Team Leader of Property Operations.

s2.text: As Team Leader, I was responsible for more than 350 units.

s3.text: I led a team of 12 people across concierge, maintenance, and housekeeping.

s4.text: I managed DTCM compliance, standard operating procedures, vendor service level agreements, and reporting.

s5.text: This role taught me how to lead a team, and how to keep standards consistent across a large portfolio.

l1.text: Next, I became the Guest Experience Lead at Luxury Homevy.

l2.text: I was responsible for the guest experience across 40 properties, and I led a team of 5.

l3.text: We communicated with guests through Hostaway and WhatsApp, and I tracked our service levels and procedures.

l4.text: I analysed more than 200 guest reviews to understand what guests value most.

l5.text: This role taught me how to use guest feedback to improve our service.

a1.text: Today, I am the Guest Relations Executive Supervisor at The Authors Holiday Homes.

a2.text: I supervise the guest relations team, and I make sure that every guest is looked after from arrival to departure.

a3.text: I handle escalated guest issues, and I coach the team to resolve problems the first time.

a4.text: I have also improved the company's systems and the way the team is managed.

a5.text: This role is teaching me how to build a team that delivers the same standard every day.

w1.text: So, why should you hire me?

w2.text: First, I have worked at every level, from the front desk to leading a team.

w4.text: Third, I build software, so I can solve operational problems at the source.

o1.text: That is the short version. Open the Work section to read the full story.

p1.text: This is PaMarket, an online marketplace that I designed and built for Zimbabwe. People use it to buy, sell, find work, and discover trusted businesses.

p2.text: Buying, selling, and job hunting were scattered across many different group chats, with no search and no protection.

p3.text: So I built one trusted place for all of it.

p4.text: People can buy and sell across all 10 provinces, find jobs, browse cars, and discover verified businesses.

p5.text: Prices can be shown in US dollars or ZiG, and listings are screened for fraud.

p6.text: It is live on the web, the App Store, and Google Play.

p7.text: It helps buyers find what they need safely, and it helps sellers reach more people.

e1.text: These are my foundations, and how each one helps me in my work.

e2.text: I have completed an Associate of Science in Computer Science.

e8.text: It is how I built PaMarket, and how I understand the systems we use at work.

e3.text: My Business Management Diploma helps me plan and lead a team, as I did at Stonetree.

e7.text: My CompTIA A+ certification helps me solve technical problems for my team in every role.

e4.text: My Bachelor of Business Administration is building the leadership I use as a supervisor today.

e5.text: My AML-CFT certificate builds on the compliance work that I did at Stonetree.

e6.text: Each one has helped me level up, and I am always learning.
